# Title: NST118 Temperature Sensor Library — Portable I2C Driver for STM32/AT32/Arduino/ESP32

# Description: Minimal C library for NST118 I2C temperature sensor (0x48/0x49, 12-bit 0.0625°C, -40..+125°C, one-shot ~20ms, shutdown, dual-sensor, no malloc). Callback-based HAL, platform-agnostic, MIT. Use with STM32 HAL, AT32, Arduino Wire, ESP-IDF.

> Minimal portable C driver for NST118 I2C temperature sensor. Callback HAL, no malloc, 12-bit, one-shot 20ms, shutdown, dual addresses 0x48/0x49.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Full bilingual guide, quick start, wiring, API
- [API Header](nst118.h): Public API with Doxygen comments
- [Platform Interface](nst118_platform.h): Callback types you must implement

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Version history
- [License](LICENSE): MIT

## Quick start for LLMs

Use `nst118_init` + `nst118_read_temperature`. Provide 3 callbacks: i2c_read(dev_addr, reg, data, len), i2c_write, delay_us. Addresses: 0x48 (AD=GND) / 0x49 (AD=VDD). Call nst118_read_temperature — triggers one-shot if in shutdown, waits ~20ms via delay_us.
